description: Create, search, and manage your Notion workspace. Read pages, query databases, update content, and organize knowledge bases with natural language.

display.description_en: Create, search, and manage your Notion workspace. Read pages, query databases, update content, and organize knowledge bases with natural language.
display.description_zh: 创建、搜索和管理 Notion 工作区。用自然语言读取页面、查询数据库、更新内容、整理知识库。
examples_en: Search all pages in my Notion containing 'weekly report', sort by last edited time, and list titles with summaries
Create a new entry in my 'Project Management' database: title is Q3 Product Roadmap, status set to In Progress, assigned to me
Query all tasks in my 'Task Board' database with status 'To Do' and due date within this week, sorted by priority
Organize today's meeting notes into a new page under 'Meeting Notes', including attendees, key discussion points, and action items
examples_zh: 搜索我 Notion 里所有包含「周报」的页面，按最近编辑时间排序，列出标题和摘要
帮我在「项目管理」数据库中新建一条记录：标题是 Q3 产品规划，状态设为进行中，负责人是我
查询「任务看板」数据库中所有状态为【待处理】且截止日期在本周内的任务，按优先级排序
把今天会议的纪要整理成一个新页面，放到「会议记录」目录下，包含参会人、讨论要点和待办事项
